{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 1
{w}Fine drinks for a lovely evening...

Be sure to drop by the Turtle's Paradise pub!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 2
{w}Worn out from a hard day at work...?

Be sure to drop by the Turtle's Paradise pub!!
Nothing beats a drink after work.

{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 3
{w}The one thing the Gold Saucer is missing... good drinks and a pub with atmosphere!

Be sure to drop by the Turtle's Paradise pub!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 4
{w}Part-timers wanted!
Seeking patient people who can put up with boredom!

Ask for details at the Turtle's Paradise pub!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 5
{w}Cocktails are nice, but nothing beats the local brew.

Be sure to drop by the Turtle's Paradise pub!!

{g}Turtle's Paradise No. 6
{w}Don't talk about Wutai until you've had a drink at Turtle's Paradise!

Look for the pub with the giant jar!!

{g}Signboard
{w}Turtle's Paradise is running a flyer campaign!
Find the "Turtle's Paradise" flyers posted all around the world. There are 6 in all.
Found them all? Tell the owner and get a little prize!
Just read the flyers - please don't take them down, for our other customers' sake!
{g}- The owner

{g}Motto of the Week
{w}Shinra's future is the world's future!!
Mako light makes a brighter world!!

{g}Men's Song
{w}Trust only in your own muscles
The sweat you shed never lies
Smile and keep jumping today
Hold back the tears and squat
That is the way of a man

{g}Zack's Letter
{w}Dear Mom and Dad,
How are you doing?
Sorry for running off from the village like that.
I really wanted to join SOLDIER. I figured you'd worry if I told you...
I'm doing great now, working hard in SOLDIER.
P.S. I got a girlfriend.
{g}- Zack

{g}Scratched on the Wall
{w}"Let's get out of here..."

{g}Scratched on the Wall
{w}"Feeding time... that's my chance..."

{g}Fugitive Report 1
{w}Date: XX/XX
The two subjects who escaped this facility have been found near Midgar.

{g}Fugitive Report 2
{g}Condition when found
{w}A: Former SOLDIER / no number. No effects of Mako exposure or Jenova observed.
B: Civilian / no number. Excessive reaction to Jenova observed.

{g}Fugitive Report 3
{g}Disposition
{w}A: Resisted; shot dead.
B: Escaped while A resisted.

{g}Fugitive Report 4
{g}Other
{w}B's whereabouts are currently unknown. However, B's mental confusion appeared well advanced, so we believe B can be left alone without causing problems.
Please advise on how to proceed.

{g}Hojo's Letter
{w}All who obstruct my research must be removed. That man from the Turks is no exception.
I modified the Turk biologically and left him sleeping in the basement. Look for him if you are curious.
But... this is only a game I thought up on a whim. You need not play along.

{g}Hojo's Letter
{w}Turn the safe's dial carefully but fast: within 20 seconds. Don't overshoot!
{g}Hints for the 4 dials
{w}Dial 1: lid of the box with the most oxygen
Dial 2: back of the black & white with no sky
Dial 3: creaky floor by the 2F chair...
From there: 5 left, 9 up, 2 left, 6 up.
